records.mechanics_notes: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate. The user advances and sweeps a powerful breath/ki wave across the target area, producing a single-hit knockback attack; the dedicated Xenoverse 2 reference describes it as unblockable. A source-reported damage figure is retained only as bounded evidence.

records.name: Innocence Bullet
records.source_quest_or_shop: Majin Buu mentor training — Initiation Test
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. The user launches paired swirling Ki Blasts that combine on impact, dealing knockback and applying poison. Current Xenoverse 2 evidence describes the poison as persisting until the opponent dies or uses an antidote.
